project.title: Better Now than Never
project.medium: Song and cover – Ableton Live, an Illustrator script
project.content:
A song by Mikato, with a cover drawn by code. Not released yet – here is the whole song as an instrumental.

Written and produced in Ableton Live at 120 BPM, in A minor; some of the bass lines were generated with small Python scripts. The cover is drawn by a script in Illustrator: thin lines in pastel rainbow colours flow across soft pink and bend around a pale sun.
